title: The hydrolysis properties of polyethylene glycol under ambient nonthermal plasma conditions
content:
Energy Adv., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5YA00163C, Paper

Parsa Pishva, Abdol Hadi Mokarizadeh, Rongxuan Xie, Jinyao Tang, Xiaochen Shen, Yanlin Zhu, Mesfin Tsige, Zhenmeng Peng
This study explores rapid, nonthermal plasma-assisted hydrolysis of polyethylene glycol (PEG) using a dielectric barrier discharge reactor under ambient conditions, achieving complete conversion to high value gas and liquid products.
